name: An Ancient Grudge
summary: Within the Hall of Thanes, Faldrim Anvilmar's spirit remains troubled by an old grievance. His ghostly attendant asks travelers to bring him peace.

sections.title: A Plea From the Grave
sections.body: A ghostly attendant remains in the Hall of Thanes, where Faldrim Anvilmar once ruled. The spirit can barely speak across the veil between the living and the dead. It asks you to quiet its master's restless spirit. It seeks peace for him, not freedom for itself.

sections.title: The Weight of the Past
sections.body: Faldrim Anvilmar remains bound to the physical world by an ancient grudge. His ghost is agitated and hostile. He cannot rest until someone grants him a forceful release.

faq.answer: Faldrim Anvilmar was a dwarven thane whose restless ghost haunts the Hall of Thanes. His Ghostly Attendant says an ancient grudge consumes him and keeps him from rest.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Thanes located?
faq.answer: The Hall of Thanes lies in caverns beneath Old Ironforge, inside the dwarven capital of Ironforge.

faq.q: Why is the ghost of Faldrim Anvilmar hostile?
faq.answer: Faldrim Anvilmar's ghost is hostile because an ancient grudge consumes him. The Ghostly Attendant says this grievance keeps the former thane from rest.

faq.q: Who gives the quest An Ancient Grudge?
faq.answer: A Ghostly Attendant inside the Hall of Thanes asks you to bring peace to its former master.

faq.q: What must you do to complete the quest?
faq.answer: You confront Faldrim Anvilmar's ghost in the Hall of Thanes and defeat him in combat to release him from torment. Then you report back to the Ghostly Attendant.

faq.q: Is Faldrim related to the town of Anvilmar?
faq.answer: No one knows whether Faldrim Anvilmar is related to the town of Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. They share a name, but his family and any tie to the town are unknown.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see a sobering reminder that an ancient grudge can outlast death itself.
As a priest, you know that lingering grudges and unatoned sorrow can bind a spirit to the physical world long after the body is dust.
As a paladin, you take on the solemn duty of bringing peace to the suffering dead.

attribution: In-game quest text: An Ancient Grudge
